items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Father O'Connor said, 'Well, I tell you, if you don't write a Mass just play it, play it on the piano, Mass.'

ctx.x: Father Crowley, he was concerned about, after he heard I had stopped playing, he was traveling around with the Newport Jazz Festival and Father O'Connor. They both were friends. So he began coming around to try to get me out to play. He came to the house and he told Dizzy and Elaine, "Mary is a saint." They said, "Why would you say this?" He said, "You should go to her house." I had people in here from the Welfare and everywhere and I was sleeping on the floor. I was feeding and clothing them and doing a lot of…
Now you weren't working at this point?
